descriptions.C01: Enter a keyword and get the top 10 to 100 Google results as a table: rank, title, URL and domain. Pick the country and language. A SERP checker and SERP analysis tool for seeing who already ranks before you write. It lists the results for a keyword; it does not track your own site's rank every day.
descriptions.C02: See the answer Google AI Mode gives for a question, together with the sites it cites. Check whether your article or a competitor is cited. A starting point for GEO and LLM SEO (generative engine optimization).
descriptions.C03: Enter a keyword and get the top local businesses on Google Maps as a table: rank, rating, review count and phone number. A Google Maps rank checker and local SEO research tool. It uses a country-wide location, so it is not the exact rank at your shop's door.
descriptions.C04: Get the Google Maps "more places" list (the local finder), including positions beyond the top 3 of the map pack. See where competing businesses sit after the local pack. A follow-up to a local rank check.
descriptions.C05: Enter a keyword or company name and get the Google News articles as a table: source, date and title. Use it for news monitoring and to see how your company or industry appears in the news.
descriptions.C07: Enter a keyword and get the top Google image results as a list of thumbnails. Use it for thumbnail ideas, book cover design inspiration and image SEO research: see what kind of images rank.
descriptions.C08: Get the Google autocomplete (search suggest) keywords for any keyword as a list. See what readers search alongside your keyword. Save the suggestions as CSV.
descriptions.C09: Enter a topic and get public datasets found by Google Dataset Search: name, provider, update date and URL. Find open data and statistics to cite in articles and books.
descriptions.C10: Search the Google Ads Transparency Center for advertisers by name. Find out whether a competitor runs Google Ads, and get the advertiser ID and an approximate ad count.
descriptions.C11: Enter a domain such as nike.com and get the Google ads currently running, with format (text, image, video) and dates. A way to research how a competitor advertises.
descriptions.C14: Enter a keyword and get the top YouTube search results as a list. Use it for YouTube SEO and competitor research: see which videos and channels fill a topic.
descriptions.C15: Enter a video URL and get its numbers as a table: views, likes and comments. Use it for YouTube video analysis and to check the numbers of a video that is taking off.
descriptions.C16: Enter a video URL and extract its comments as a list, then export them to CSV. Use it to read honest opinions in the comments of product review videos.
descriptions.C17: Get the full subtitle text of a video as a transcript. It works only for videos that have subtitles; it does not turn speech into text. Handy for reading a video's content as text.
descriptions.C18: See the answer ChatGPT gives to a question, as is. Check whether your brand is recommended when customers ask. A starting point for LLM SEO and AI search optimization.
descriptions.C19: See the answer Claude gives to a question. Compare it with ChatGPT and Gemini, and check how your brand or a competitor is described.
descriptions.C20: See the answer Gemini gives to a question. Compare Gemini vs ChatGPT and check whether your brand appears.
descriptions.C21: See the answer Perplexity gives, together with the sources it cites. Find out which sites Perplexity cites for a question: a starting point for Perplexity SEO and LLM SEO.
descriptions.C22: See the products and cited sources ChatGPT search returns for a shopping-style question. Check whether your product appears in ChatGPT search and shopping results.
descriptions.C23: See how often a topic is asked in AI search such as ChatGPT search. Check whether a topic is a popular AI question: a keyword research tool for AI search.
descriptions.C24: Enter keywords one per line and get monthly search volume, CPC, competition and a 12-month trend per keyword. Up to 1,000 keywords per call for $0.09; longer lists are split automatically (up to 5,000). A bulk search volume checker and a Keyword Planner alternative.
descriptions.C25: Enter a domain and get keyword ideas that fit the site, with search volume and CPC. Use it for competitor keyword research and to find keywords to target. Based on Google Ads data.
descriptions.C26: Enter a keyword and get related keyword ideas from Google Ads data, with search volume and CPC. The same data source as Keyword Planner: use it for PPC keyword selection and SEO ideas.
descriptions.C29: Enter keywords and get Google Trends data as a table: past movement week by week, with several keywords side by side for comparison. Export to CSV. Use it to see when interest peaks and how seasonal a topic is.
descriptions.C30: Enter a keyword and get search popularity (0 to 100) over time, week by week, as a chart and a table. See whether a topic is rising or fading. The last week is dropped if it is still in progress.
descriptions.C31: Enter a keyword and see search popularity by state or region as a table and a bar chart. Find where a keyword is searched most: regional keyword research and local targeting.
descriptions.C32: Enter a keyword and see the age groups and the gender split of the people searching for it, as tables and bar charts. A quick read on who your audience is.
descriptions.C33: Enter a keyword and see which countries search for it, with each country's share. Check whether a keyword is searched abroad: international keyword research and international SEO.
descriptions.C34: Enter a domain and get keywords related to the site, with search volume and keyword difficulty. A keyword research tool for finding keywords that fit a blog or website.
descriptions.C35: Enter a keyword and get related keywords and related searches as a list, with search volume and keyword difficulty. Find what to write next, and semantic keywords to cover.
descriptions.C36: Enter a keyword and get the long-tail keywords that contain it, as a list with search volume and keyword difficulty. Find keyword variations and combinations with less competition.
